title: Titanium Ceramic Heater Clamp Plate
system: Plasma Chamber Liners, Shields & Thermal Hardware
alloyReason: Bead-blasted Grade 2 CP-Ti (UNS R50400) is chosen for this chamber shield component where controlled Ra 3.2-6.3um roughness improves coating adhesion. The 345 MPa yield with 30% elongation provides ductility while maintaining corrosion resistance. This rationale is driven by ceramic heater core clamping plate and specific design requirements.
process: Cleanroom CNC Class 100 for chamber shield geometry
UHP DI water cascade rinse at 200W fiber laser
Particle count MIL-STD-1246 at 200W fiber laser
surfaceTreatment: Electropolishing Ra <0.25um + UHP DI cascade rinse with particle count verification per MIL-STD-1246 Class 1
commonFailures: Metal particle shedding >1e10 at/cm2 - eliminated by UHP VAR+ESR double-melt + electropolished ID

faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Ceramic Heater Clamp Plate suitable for Ceramic heater core clamping plate?
faq.a: Titanium Ceramic Heater Clamp Plate uses Grade 2 CP-Ti because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address chamber shield operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Ceramic Heater Clamp Plate?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Ceramic Heater Clamp Plate require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. chamber shield components receive Electropolishing Ra <0.25um + UHP DI cascade rinse with particle count verification per MIL-STD-1246 Class 1. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the service environment.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Ceramic Heater Clamp Plate shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements; (4) Surface roughness certification on critical features. FAIR available on request.

faq.q: What is the MOQ and typical lead time for Heater clamp / Ceramic clamp chamber shield components?
faq.a: Standard MOQ: 1 unit for prototype evaluation. Production lead time: 15-25 business days depending on quantity. Rush orders (3-5 days) available. Contact our supply chain team for volume-based tiered pricing.
